CustomField.description: When on, logs a performance entry for web service and API operations, and for each async chain step, that take Performance Threshold (ms) or longer. It also controls the entry for a whole async chain run when Async Chain Performance Threshold (ms) is blank. When that field holds a number, the whole-run entry follows that number only, even with this setting off.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to log web service operations, API operations and async chain steps that take Performance Threshold (ms) or longer. It also controls whole async chain runs while Async Chain Performance Threshold (ms) is blank.
CustomField.label: Enable Performance Logging
